misses.counterfactual_theory: A linked record of each forecast’s frozen specification, issuance time, evidence cutoff, and matured outcome could make it possible to assess what was knowable and whether a forecast missed. The supplied evidence does not establish that this information would have changed a decision or prevented an error.
misses.decision_reference: No eligible prior decision or forecast specification is linked to the supplied settlement records; see EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE in the supplied registry.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the forecast specification and decision-time information boundary, the target-time prices cannot establish forecast accuracy or a decision failure.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices are supplied, but no linked prior forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff is available. The settlement timestamps are adjudication targets, not decision or source-observation times. No forecast or decision miss is demonstrated.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Target-time settlement prices alone cannot show what was knowable beforehand or whether a forecast missed.
misses.outcome_reference: Supplied FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records (including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 and other listed EXP-FC records); EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES validation states these prices are not linked to prior forecast specifications.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
